# ultimate-crm-template

> A free, industry-neutral CRM for field-service businesses (leads, quotes, jobs, invoices, payments, crew and client portals, texts, an AI assistant) that an AI agent turns into one business's own private CRM.

If a person shared this repository with you, read the AI guide first.

## Start here
- [AI guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/F0rger123/ultimate-crm-template/main/docs/SETUP_WIZARD.md): what it is, what to ask, setup steps, how to use it

- [Rules for every agent](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/F0rger123/ultimate-crm-template/main/AGENTS.md)
